fields.subnational_unit: national (Ethiopia); consultation with experts from the Ministry of Water and Energy, regional water bureaus, zonal offices, universities, research centres and consulting firms
fields.population: Ethiopia, national IWRM implementation system, modelled as a network of barriers (variables) and causal links; six professional experts consulted to validate variables and link polarities
fields.sample_size: 6 experts consulted individually (in person); 142 causal connections (117 direct, 25 inverse) among the barrier variables; variables drawn from a narrative literature review of studies 2006-2025
fields.effect_measure: semi-quantitative systems analysis (causal loop diagram in Kumu.io/Vensim PLE, eigenvector centrality, MICMAC influence-dependence classification, structural loop-gain index in Excel); explicitly not an estimate of statistical effects
fields.effect_estimate: Six leverage points emerge as system connectors for SDG 6.5.1 implementation: household income level, access to reliable water supply, governance effectiveness, economic water scarcity, food availability and access, and irrigation coverage. A reinforcing loop links water access, livelihoods, food availability and economic water scarcity; a balancing loop links governance effectiveness and infrastructure investment, constrained by institutional fragmentation and finance. The authors state the rankings are structural importance indices, not effect sizes, p-values or confidence intervals, and that the model is static, sensitive to variable selection and assumed causal direction, and unvalidated by simulation.
fields.model_type: semi-quantitative systems modelling (causal loop diagram, eigenvector centrality, MICMAC, loop gain)
fields.study_design: systems-thinking modelling study built from a narrative literature review and six-expert consultation; not an empirical study of legal or administrative measures
fields.section: Full text (Discover Sustainability 7:733, open access): Abstract; Methodology 2.1-2.6; Results 3.1-3.6; Discussion 4
fields.exact_location: Abstract; 2.1 variable identification and expert consultation; 2.6 limitations; 3 results preamble (no hypothesis tests); 3.1 142 links

evidence_level: Conceptual / modelling evidence: a semi-quantitative systems analysis of barriers to IWRM operationalisation in Ethiopia (literature-derived variables, six expert consultations, 142 causal links), read in full text 2026-10-04. Identifies six leverage points including governance effectiveness and a balancing governance-infrastructure loop constrained by institutional fragmentation. No empirical effect estimate; the authors disclaim statistical inference. Not an empirical test of a legal rule.
